title: Read the supplied feedback sorter
description: You can inspect the example data and bucket logic before substituting your own review cards.

steps.description: FEEDBACK contains example reviewer, kind, and text triples. The TODO requests real cards from your team.
CLASSIFICATION supplies decisions for the example text. Separate lists hold strengths and the four action buckets.

steps.question: Where does a non-strength card go if its text has no classification entry?
steps.answer: It goes into UNCLASSIFIED through the dictionary lookup's default.

steps.description: Strengths are collected separately. The remaining cards are printed under the supplied bucket names.
The current data produces three FIX entries and no unclassified cards. Assigning owners and dates remains a TODO rather than an implemented output.
